author: Homeless_Pigeon
quote:
The game is actively bad and there hasn’t been any redeeming factors that have made the game actually fun for me. There are aspects of the game that are technically solid and in some respects impressive but this is an $80 game. This is a AAA release. This is not a fun game. The mortality mechanics in a game where the people buying it want to do immoral things. The game is named after what we call the act of stealing a car for crying out loud. The constant getting text messages, phone calls, how the morality system forces you into stealth in an action game, the chores. Like my god please fire every developer. I have had more fun playing indie games like power wash simulator which is actually fun. Graphics are cool and that’s what we pay a premium for but the game isn’t worth anything if it isn’t fun to begin with.

The relationship aspect also takes way to much of a front seat. It would have been fine if every now and then we had to do some bs for her and carry on but it’s constant. I have my wife asking me to do enough stuff in real life that’s boring and I don’t want to do. I do it for her because she is real and I love her I don’t want to be doing this nonsense for some fake virtual girl I have no feelings for that’s so dumb. Could have been a cool dynamic if it wasn’t so tedious. I could genuinely go on but I really don’t want to waste more time on this garbage.
